method: Agent-driven adb input, Android UIAutomator hierarchy, actual screencap, and byte comparison; this JSON summarizes observed checks, not an unexecuted test script.

checks.name: Android document-picker import and exact retry
checks.observation: Selected journal-0.aura and its receipt through Downloads. Final APK retry kept one capture and preserved the edited title.

checks.name: Private note survives restart and update
checks.observation: The original and edited title/context remained after process exit, preserved-data emulator restart and replacement APK installation.

checks.name: Actual MediaPlayer playback
checks.observation: Final APK displayed advancing playback, reached 0:08, and returned to Play recording. Host audio was disabled; this is not an audible-output quality test.

checks.name: Small-screen context editor
checks.observation: Long unsaved draft scrolled while Cancel and Save stayed above the open keyboard; tapping Cancel retained the exact saved manual context.

checks.name: Explicit context copy and share
checks.observation: Clipboard paste and the actual share-sheet preview matched exactly, including manual-context qualification and original source SHA-256. No receiving app was selected.

checks.name: Original export via document picker
checks.observation: Final APK wrote the selected Downloads destination; independently read exported bytes match the original archive exactly.

checks.name: System Back
checks.observation: Final APK API29 Back returned from recording detail to the library.

limits: The first new import, saved title/context and clipboard copy were exercised before the final keyboard-layout correction; final APK checked retained data, import retry, long-draft cancellation, share payload, playback and byte-exact export.
No sudden-power-loss trial, physical phone, headset route, other-app audio focus, modern predictive Back, Bluetooth transfer or vendor document-provider matrix.
Returning from another activity can reset the current detail scroll position.
